import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: Technology Trends & Price Dynamics', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (scatter plot)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(sensor_types))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Evolution of megapixels over years by sensor type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
yearly_mp = df.groupby(['model_year', 'sensor_type'])['megapixels'].mean().reset_index()
for sensor in sensor_types:
    data = yearly_mp[yearly_mp['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax2.plot(data['model_year'], data['megapixels'], 
            marker='o', linewidth=2, label=sensor, markersize=6)
ax2.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Megapixel Evolution by Sensor Type Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Price distribution by brand (top 8 brands)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8).index
df_top_brands = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)]
brand_order = df_top_brands.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df_top_brands, y='brand', x='price_usd', 
           order=brand_order, ax=ax3, palette='Set2')
ax3.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Price Distribution by Top 8 Brands', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 4. 4K Video adoption and weight distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
video_4k_counts = df.groupby(['model_year', 'has_video_4k']).size().reset_index(name='count')
video_4k_pivot = video_4k_counts.pivot(index='model_year', columns='has_video_4k', values='count').fillna(0)
if 0 in video_4k_pivot.columns and 1 in video_4k_pivot.columns:
    video_4k_pivot['4K_percentage'] = (video_4k_pivot[1] / (video_4k_pivot[0] + video_4k_pivot[1])) * 100
else:
    video_4k_pivot['4K_percentage'] = 0

ax4_twin = ax4.twinx()
years = video_4k_pivot.index
ax4.bar(years, video_4k_pivot['4K_percentage'], alpha=0.7, color='steelblue', label='% with 4K')
yearly_weight = df.groupby('model_year')['weight_grams'].mean()
ax4_twin.plot(yearly_weight.index, yearly_weight.values, 
             color='red', marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=7, label='Avg Weight')

ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('% Cameras with 4K Video', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='steelblue')
ax4_twin.set_ylabel('Average Weight (grams)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='red')
ax4.set_title('4K Video Adoption & Camera Weight Trends', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='steelblue')
ax4_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='red')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

lines1, labels1 = ax4.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax4_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax4.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
